case_title: SANTOS ABEL VS V & H AUTO SPORTS

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $116.00 FILED BY SANTOS ABEL AS TO DEFENDANT V & H AUTO SPORTS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-05-1993 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 02

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SANTOS ABEL IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT V & H AUTO SPORTS STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
